tip: Cocktails roughly ฿400-500. Good sunset alternative to the tourist-heavy bars. Smart casual

name: Amorosa & The Deck (Arun Residence)
vibe: Small riverside rooftop staring straight at Wat Arun's lit-up prang across the water
tip: Arrive by 17:30 for a rail seat at sunset. Drinks mid-priced. Walk from Tha Tien pier

name: Above Riva (Riva Arun Bangkok)
vibe: Rooftop dining with a panoramic river view framing Wat Arun at golden hour
tip: Book a front-row table for sunset. Pair with a wooden boat ride from Tha Maharaj

name: Yodsiam Sunset Party Cruise
vibe: Two-hour river party boat at sunset with free-flow beer, buffet and live music past the lit temples
tip: From ~US$28 (about ฿1,000). Meet at Asiatique. Alcohol 21+, bring ID. Book online

name: Chao Phraya Tourist Boat (Blue Flag) at sunset
vibe: The cheap sunset cruise: ride upriver past Wat Arun and the Grand Palace as the sky goes orange
tip: About ฿30 single or ฿150 day pass from Sathorn Pier (BTS Saphan Taksin). Sit on the left going north

name: Tha Tien to Wat Arun Cross-River Ferry
vibe: Few-baht ferry hop with the best close-up of Wat Arun from the water
tip: Only a few baht. Ride across at sunset and back, or just stand on the pier. Last boats around 22:00

name: Rattanakosin Exhibition Hall Rooftop
vibe: Museum rooftop with a postcard view over Loha Prasat's iron spires and the Golden Mount
tip: ฿100 foreigners, ฿70 Thai. Tue-Sun 09:00-17:00, closed Mondays. Go near closing for softer light

name: Wat Traimit (Golden Buddha) upper terrace
vibe: 5.5-tonne solid gold Buddha on top of a white tower with a terrace looking over Chinatown roofs
tip: About ฿100 for the Golden Buddha hall. Cover shoulders and knees. Then walk into Yaowarat for food

name: Victory Monument Skywalk Ring
vibe: Elevated ring walkway circling the obelisk, a free spot for traffic light-trail shots at night
tip: Free, connects to BTS Victory Monument. Go after dark for long-exposure traffic photos

name: Bangkok Helicopter Tour
vibe: Private chopper over the Chao Phraya, skyscrapers and Erawan elephant, ideally right at sunset
tip: Very pricey: about ฿20,000 for a weekend sunset hop up to ฿50,000+ for 30 min. Book days ahead, pickup included

name: Dream World
vibe: Old-school theme park with coasters, a drop tower, a cable car over the park and Snow Town
tip: Book the unlimited-rides pass online for a discount. Go on weekdays to skip queues. About 1h drive north

name: Siam Amazing Park
vibe: Bangkok's biggest amusement park with the Vortex inverted coaster and a huge wave pool
tip: Buy tickets online, often with buffet included. Weekdays are quiet. Bring a change of clothes for the water zone

name: Thai Wake Park
vibe: Cable wake park with kickers and rails where Bangkok riders learn tricks till late
tip: About ฿850 for 2 hours, all-day ฿1,350, board rental extra. Free basic coaching. Grab from Don Mueang area

name: Taco Lake (Bueng Tako) Cable Wake Park
vibe: Thailand's first cable wake park, cheap day passes and night sessions under lights
tip: Day pass around ฿400-600, gear rental on site. Weekdays from noon, weekends from 10, open to 22:00. Off Bang Na-Trat Rd

name: Zanook Wake Park
vibe: West-side cable park with obstacles, chill crowd and wakeboard sessions into the evening
tip: Rides from about ฿500-750. Weekends open from 09:00, weekdays from late morning. Check their Facebook before going

name: IMPACT Speed Park
vibe: Real outdoor kart circuit, 800-900m of tarmac with proper race karts and timing
tip: About ฿650 per adult session. Mon-Fri 14-22, weekends 10-22. Book weekends ahead, closed track during heavy rain

name: IMPACT Drift Park
vibe: Drift karts that slide sideways round a timed track, next door to IMPACT Speed Park
tip: Pair it with a Speed Park session. Prices not published, call Novotel IMPACT +66 2 833 4888 to confirm it is running

name: TopKart Bangkok
vibe: Outdoor 270cc kart track right in the city, race your mates after work
tip: Open daily 10-22. Rain pauses the track 30-40 min. Call 098 274 9777 to confirm. Near Central Chidlom on Phetchaburi Rd

name: E-Gokart Track by Monowheel (Banthat Thong)
vibe: Neon-lit electric kart track open around the clock, perfect 2am adrenaline after Banthat Thong food
tip: Regular ฿350, Plus mode ฿650 hits 40 km/h. Max 190cm and 90kg. Walk from BTS National Stadium

name: Rogue Marina Airsoft Battle Arena
vibe: Big airsoft battle arena with team deathmatch, capture point and one-life rounds
tip: About ฿765-800 incl. gun and safety gear, bullets ฿240 per bag. Wed-Fri 15-23, weekends 12-20. Near Rama IX Bridge

name: Bangkok ATV Adventures (Suksawat Rama 2)
vibe: Muddy quad bike trails on the edge of the city, guided rides for all levels
tip: About $34 per person on Klook or GetYourGuide. Tue-Sun 08-18, closed Mon. Wear closed shoes, take a Grab

name: Zero Latency VR (EmQuartier)
vibe: Free-roam VR arena: run around a warehouse with a backpack rig shooting zombies with your squad
tip: Book a slot online, groups up to 8. Level 4 Glass Quartier, BTS Phrom Phong. Open roughly 10/11:00-20:00

name: Warpoint Bangkok (Gateway Ekamai)
vibe: Multiplayer free-roam VR shooter arena, like paintball in a video game
tip: 3rd floor Gateway Ekamai, direct link from BTS Ekkamai. Book ahead for groups, check current hours on socials

name: Harbor Island (The Mall Lifestore Bang Khae)
vibe: New 2026 elevated water park with Thailand's steepest kamikaze slide and a 130m Sky Rider
tip: Opened March 2026, around ฿550-680 per person. 3rd floor The Mall Bang Khae, MRT Lak Song. Go on weekdays

name: Escape Room Thailand (MBK)
vibe: Horror escape rooms like Overlook Hotel: Room 13 and Slaughter House with creepy soundtracks
tip: About ฿550 per person, 45 min, 2-8 players. 7th floor MBK, BTS National Stadium. Pick the horror rooms

name: Puzzle Room Bangkok
vibe: Escape games on Sukhumvit 18 with rotating themes like haunted hotel, zombies and Jack the Ripper
tip: About ฿555-888 per person. 11:00-23:00 daily. BTS Asok exit 4 into Soi 18. Ask which room is the scariest

name: Channel 7 Boxing Stadium
vibe: Free live Muay Thai every Sunday afternoon, rowdy local gamblers and TV cameras
tip: Free entry, Sundays about 14:30-16:30. Arrive an hour early for ringside. Walk from BTS Mo Chit after Chatuchak

name: Siam Omnoi Boxing Stadium
vibe: Gritty suburban stadium with Saturday TV fight cards, zero tourist polish
tip: Saturdays around 12:15-14:15, pay at the door. Foreigner price quoted ฿1,500. Grab out along Phetkasem Rd

name: Peppermint Bike Park
vibe: Urban mountain bike park with an extreme black track of berms and drops, lit up at night
tip: About ฿150 day, ฿200 night (18-22). Bring your own bike. Soi Yothin Phattana 3. Confirm on Facebook first

name: Blessing Shophouse
vibe: Hidden two-storey family townhouse turned Chinese-spice cocktail den, plum blossoms and lucky symbols everywhere
tip: Entrance moved to the back alley behind 6-5 Sukhumvit 14, so walk around the building. Wed-Sun 6pm-midnight. Book on weekends.

name: Sugar Ray, You've Just Been Poisoned (Sukhumvit 24)
vibe: Cult Ekkamai speakeasy reborn in black marble behind a seafood bar, playful cocktails and a costumed doorman
tip: Go into Octo Seafood Bar at 88/2 Sukhumvit 24 and find the costumed doorman who leads you in. From 7pm, closed Mon. Smart casual.

name: Ku Bar
vibe: Minimalist third-floor speakeasy in an old printing house, avant-garde seasonal cocktails for the in-crowd
tip: No sign. Climb to the 3rd floor of 469 Phra Sumen Rd. Small room, so message ahead on IG and go early in the week.

name: The Last Call
vibe: Closet-sized 10-seat whisky and cocktail micro-bar, now an official Nikka Whisky Embassy
tip: 413 Thong Lo between Soi 10 and 12. Reservations essential (+66 96 612 0532). Often closed Fri and Sat, so go midweek.

name: Black Cabin
vibe: Red-lit jungle cabin hideaway with nightly live acts and creative cocktails
tip: Thonglor Soi 16, every night from 7pm. Reserve seats via LINE @BLACKCABINBAR and check Facebook for the monthly lineup.

name: Wasteland
vibe: Upcycled zero-waste cocktail lab tucked in Edison Alley, reclaimed fridges as decor
tip: 3/19 Pridi Banomyong Soi 1, Edison Alley, a short walk from BTS Phra Khanong. Sit at the bar and talk to the team. Daily 6pm-midnight.

name: 1970 Bar (Dusit Thani)
vibe: Retro-glam 1970s lounge in the rebuilt Dusit Thani, velvet, vinyl and sophisticated cocktails
tip: Inside the new Dusit Thani Bangkok on Rama IV. Book a table on TableCheck for weekend live sets. Smart casual.

name: Spectrum Lounge & Bar (Hyatt Regency Sukhumvit)
vibe: Sleek 29th/30th-floor rooftop with DJs every night and deep, melodic house takeovers
tip: Lift to level 29/30. DJs 8:30pm-midnight nightly. No sandals, vests or sportswear. Book a rail seat for sunset.

name: The Key Room No.72 (Josh Hotel)
vibe: Wes Anderson style hotel hides a secret room behind an unmarked black wall
tip: Ask the Josh Hotel front desk for 'a key' like a check-in (small deposit), then find the black wall. Daily 6pm-1am.

name: Stella (Capella Bangkok)
vibe: Glittering jewel-box cocktail bar inside ultra-luxe Capella, made for a special night
tip: Inside Capella Bangkok, 300/2 Charoen Krung. Reserve for weekends and dress up. Pair with a riverside stroll after.

name: Abandoned Mansion
vibe: Gangster-era underground jazz and cigar bar two floors below a hotel lobby
tip: Head down the red-carpeted stairs to B2 of The Coach Hotel, 41 Sukhumvit 14. Jazz nights are the move. Book on 02 259 7007.

name: Philtration
vibe: Basement apothecary speakeasy pouring Chinese-medicine cocktails in a heritage compound
tip: 2 Kasemsan Soi 3: walk through the heritage compound, turn left, find the door by the antique medicine cabinet.

name: Door No.6
vibe: Tiny speakeasy hiding in the back of a bespoke tailor, just six drinks named Doors 1 to 6
tip: 25/1 Sukhumvit Soi 6. Walk through the tailoring shop to the back. Tue-Sun 5pm-1am. Call 080-356-3959 to hold seats.

name: 2463 Speakeasy
vibe: 1920s Prohibition bar behind a fake vintage tailor shop, password at the door
tip: 8 Sukhumvit 63. Tell the 'tailor' the weekly password from their Facebook/IG or call 097 263 2463. Tue-Sun 7pm-2am.

name: Rogue Affair
vibe: Spy-themed James Bond style cocktail lounge hidden on a hotel's 5th floor
tip: 5th floor of PASSA Hotel, 63 Saladaeng Soi 2. Free entry, Wed-Sun 6pm-1am. Order the Excommunicado.

name: Cherry Olive Cocktail Club
vibe: BK's Best New Bar 2026: two moods, playful Cherry side vs classic Olive side
tip: 10 Convent Rd. Pick a side based on your mood. Pair with nearby Vesper for a Convent Rd crawl. Book Fri/Sat.

name: Ruby's (Kimpton Maa-Lai)
vibe: 16-seat gem-themed hidden bar tucked inside Ms.Jigger, old-Bangkok glamour cocktails
tip: Ground floor of Kimpton Maa-Lai, 78 Soi Ton Son: ask at Ms.Jigger for Ruby's. Tiny room, book ahead. Daily 5:30pm-midnight.

name: SoolHaus (Canopy by Hilton Sukhumvit)
vibe: Seoul-style soju bar with DJs spinning house, R&B and K-pop and a 10:30pm group shot ritual
tip: Level L, Building B, Canopy by Hilton, 98 Sukhumvit Soi 12. DJs Fri and Sat. Arrive before 10:30pm for the geonbae toast.

name: The Pickwick Chronicles
vibe: Dickens-themed literary mystery bar off Langsuan, drinks named after his characters
tip: 76/10 Lumphini, off Langsuan. Daily 6pm-1am. Thursday is women-only SipAndSparkle, so couples go Fri/Sat.

name: Arcadia Live
vibe: 80s cyberpunk barcade reborn with a central DJ booth, live stage and a secret film-set hotel upstairs
tip: 1112/91-93 Sukhumvit Plus Soi 1 near BTS Phra Khanong, look for the blue-lit dragon. Check IG for DJ nights. BK Best Theme Bar 2026.

name: Blaq Lyte Bloq
vibe: New home of the Blaq Lyte crew: tight sound system, deep house, minimal and melodic techno
tip: 251/1 Thonglor Soi 13. Follow @blaqlyte for lineups and tickets on RA. Parties run roughly 7pm-3am. Closed shoes.

name: Fuchsia
vibe: Pink retro-futuristic Parisian-style club in an unmarked Decho Rd building, techno-house nights
tip: Unmarked building on Decho Rd, walk from BTS Chong Nonsi. 350-700 THB with a drink on event nights. Pair with Mustache next door.

name: 24 BLVD
vibe: Open-air hi-so nightlife hub on Soi 24, afro and organic house parties into club hopping
tip: 88/9 Sukhumvit 24. Weekends go party mode; Upper House club is on 2F. Bring your original passport, no slippers or gym wear.

name: Japanish Rooftop
vibe: 19th-floor Soi 11 rooftop open till 4am with rotating deep and melodic house lineups
tip: 19F Ramada by Wyndham, Sukhumvit Soi 11. Open till 04:00, so it works as an after-club rooftop. Book via Chope.

name: Bar 335
vibe: Tiny YOLO Group counter bar built around music and late-night regulars
tip: Now on Sukhumvit 39. Very few seats, so come solo or as a pair. Daily 8pm-midnight. Watch IG for guest DJ nights.

name: Q&A Bar
vibe: Moody Asok classic hiding behind a green marble wall with a tiny sign
tip: 235/13 Sukhumvit 21 (Asok Rd). Look for the small plaque on the green marble wall. Mon-Sat 7pm-2am.

name: Sugar Club
vibe: Soi 11 late-license club for when you want a big dance floor after rooftops
tip: Sukhumvit Soi 11, busiest after midnight on weekends. Guest list via promoters. Bring passport, no shorts or sandals.

name: 008 Bar (MUU Bangkok)
vibe: Hidden 11th-floor hotel bar in Thonglor with a Bond-esque low-light lounge feel
tip: Ride to 11F of MUU Bangkok (ex-Akyra Thonglor), 88/333 Sukhumvit 55. Daily 6pm-1am. Good warm-up before Thonglor clubs.

name: Hannibal
vibe: Hidden 10th-floor Chinatown bar with nightly DJs, Guan Yu statues and cocktails rolled down a bowling lane.
tip: Enter Pichaiyart Building (the one with Lotus's), lift to 10F, walk the neon corridor past massage and karaoke rooms to a heavy door.

name: Widdershins
vibe: Western-style hideaway tucked inside a Chinese restaurant, built around a giant wall clock.
tip: Go through Laoteng restaurant on Yaowarat. Draw a card and let the bartender make you a custom drink.

name: Goldsmith Bar
vibe: 1930s Shanghai and Silk Road styled speakeasy upstairs from a Hong Kong diner.
tip: Climb the stairs above Chop Chop Cook Shop on Yaowarat. Closed Mon-Tue.

name: Vol de Nuit, The Hidden Bar
vibe: Marble-lit European speakeasy at the back of an art space, with a leafy courtyard garden bar.
tip: Walk through L'Envol Art Space on Soi Suan Phlu to the back. Garden Bar is the move on cooler nights.

name: The Reading Room (Rangoon Tea House)
vibe: Vintage library bar with green armchairs, sultry light and a small outdoor terrace.
tip: Head upstairs above Rangoon Tea House. Try the Tokyo Nights section of the menu.

name: Thaipioka
vibe: Unmarked wooden door, jazz early then hip-hop and dancing late. World's 50 Best Discovery pick.
tip: Find the unmarked wooden door at the Salil Hotel. Weekdays for cocktails, Fri-Sat for dancing.

name: Crimson Room
vibe: Roaring Twenties theatre bar with private booths, velvet drama and live jazz.
tip: In Velaa Sindhorn Village off Langsuan. Book a booth for dates; dress up a little.
sources: https://www.timeout.com/bangkok/th/things-to-do/ดื่มด่ำความดรามาในค่ำคืนพิเศษที่-crimson-room

name: The Red Door (Staybridge Suites)
vibe: Parisian cafe-bar up front, a DJ club zone hidden in the back, live jazz some nights.
tip: Go to 3F of Staybridge Suites on Soi 24. Push through to the back room for the DJ. Closed Mon.

name: Aqua Bar (Anantara Siam)
vibe: Asia's 50 Best Bars 2026 entry inside a grand hotel, polished and quietly glamorous.
tip: Inside Anantara Siam near BTS Ratchadamri. Smart casual. Great pre-dinner stop before Langsuan or Lumpini.

name: La Copita
vibe: Tiny standing agave bar run by rotating bartenders from Opium Bar, menu changes weekly.
tip: Standing room only, so treat it as a first or last stop on a Chinatown crawl. Closed Tue-Wed.

name: The National Bar
vibe: Cocktails inside a historic Song Wat Road building with a Van Gogh lightbox and stories on tap.
tip: Ask staff for the building's history. Pair with a walk down Song Wat before it gets late.

name: Thurty 30
vibe: Speakeasy-style room on Soi Nana with vintage sofas and cocktails based on life stories.
tip: Easy add to a Soi Nana crawl with G.O.D and Tep Bar. Grab a sofa early on weekends.

name: NANA'
vibe: Small izakaya-style bar with craft beer, complex cocktails and a casual rooftop perch.
tip: Head up to the rooftop seats for a breather between Soi Nana bars. Open till 2am.

name: Cul de Sac (The Quartier Hotel)
vibe: 1980s backyard-on-a-roof bar with a giant outdoor movie screen and games.
tip: Take the lift to 10F. Go Fri-Sat when it runs to 2am, or catch a movie night.

name: Flashback Rooftop Bar
vibe: Retro-neon low-rise rooftop with a pool, BTS skyline views and live bands.
tip: 9F of Tastoria Collection on Soi 20. Try the cult northern sausage spaghetti.

name: Sky on 20 (Novotel Sukhumvit 20)
vibe: Laid-back 26th-floor rooftop with a live DJ most nights and wide Sukhumvit views.
tip: Casual dress OK. Arrive around 6pm for sunset and the first DJ sets.

name: Vanilla Sky (SKYVIEW Hotel)
vibe: 35th-floor 360-degree rooftop over the EM District with live DJs nightly.
tip: Smart casual: no sleeveless shirts, flip-flops or big bags. Sunset slot is the one to book.

name: Mimi's Rooftop (dusitD2 Samyan)
vibe: 25th-floor open-air rooftop that runs from sunset drinks into DJ-fuelled late parties.
tip: Go for sunset, stay for the DJ. Big themed parties (NYE etc.) are ticketed. Book via Chope.

name: What's Happened?
vibe: Hidden club behind a deliberately discreet door, theatrical rooms and DJs mixing commercial and underground.
tip: 5F EmSphere, Em Wonder zone. Book ahead on weekends, dress smart (no flip-flops), check lineup on IG.

name: BEEF. BKK
vibe: Packed 9th-floor queer club playing house, pop and disco to a crowd that actually dances.
tip: B400 entry includes two drinks. Saturday queues can hit two hours, so arrive before 10pm.

name: The Consul (Yang Club)
vibe: Private members' club on the top floors of JLK Tower, with a Jackson Wang-curated music and culture club inside.
tip: Members only for most areas. Non-members can book public events like the Sunday caviar tea. Inquire via the club.

name: Soho House Bangkok
vibe: Southeast Asia's first Soho House, rooftop pool and DJ-led sunset pool parties for members.
tip: Members and their guests only. Get a member to sign you in for a sunset pool party.

name: Berlin BKK
vibe: New 2026 Berlin-blueprint techno room hidden on the 5th floor of a Japanese discount mall
tip: Fri-Sat only, 10:30pm-3:45am. Check RA for the lineup (Moodyboom, Kunanon). Expect around 300-500 THB at the door.

name: Amnesia RCA (INAKOMA Fridays)
vibe: Weekly budget hard-techno rave with free early drinks and heavy production
tip: INAKOMA runs every Friday 10pm-4am, listed on RA. Around 400-500 THB, free beers 10pm-midnight. Bring passport, 20+.

name: Blaq Lyte Rover & Blaq Lyte 11
vibe: Industrial neon club from the BLAQ LYTE crew: Void-powered main room plus a leather-couch backroom
tip: Rover rocks Fri-Sat, the Blaq Lyte 11 backroom runs Wed, Thu and Sun. Often free before 11pm, then about 260 THB with a drink. Follow @blaqlyte.

name: Avve
vibe: Five-storey raw event building where crews like Sacristy throw techno and DnB raves
tip: No fixed schedule: watch RA for avve, Sacristy and Rave RoomZ nights. Typically 200 THB, 11pm-3:30am, 20+.

name: Begrüntes Haus
vibe: Under-the-radar house-turned-party space hosting experimental techno series like BALK / INIT
tip: Only opens for events. Find dates on the RA Bangkok guide, then DM the promoter for the location details.

name: Bangkok Island (party barge)
vibe: A converted sand barge with two decks that cruises the Chao Phraya while house DJs play
tip: Resonate BKK (UK deep house/minimal crew) runs sunset-to-midnight boat parties. 300-650 THB online, 800 at the door. Book via RA or bangkokisland.com.
hours: Event days, often 3pm or 6pm to midnight

name: Levels Club & Lounge (The Terrace)
vibe: Big Soi 11 club where the open-air terrace runs house and melodic techno while the main room goes commercial
tip: Head straight to The Terrace for house and melodic techno, nightly. Open until late on the 4am-licence soi. Reserve tables via clubbable.

name: CHUPA BKK
vibe: Glossy galaxy-themed luxury club one floor below Tichuca, where the rooftop crowd ends up
tip: Go up for sunset at Tichuca, then drop one floor when the party starts. Daily 8pm-2am. Dress sharp; call 083 494 5666 for tables.

name: Ambient Bar BKK
area: Old Town (Samran Rat, near Giant Swing)
vibe: Tiny Old Town vinyl bar for strictly-vinyl soul, house and ambient sessions
tip: Free entry nights such as The Doorway Sessions (strictly vinyl) are listed on RA. Pair it with Bar Temp. nearby in Chinatown.

name: Bangkok Community Radio (BCR)
vibe: Grassroots radio studio where Bangkok's underground DJs stream, gather and throw community parties
tip: Follow BCR on IG for open studio nights and BCR Soundsystem parties, often held at Clutch / The Warehouse with the RomRom crew.

name: House of Heals
vibe: 33rd-floor queer-friendly rooftop with rotating DJs and drag, high above the city
tip: Closed Tuesday. Fri-Sun runs until 2am. Book a window table.

name: SEEN Restaurant & Bar (Avani+ Riverside)
vibe: Glam riverside sky-dining that turns into vocal deep house and Latin DJ sets after dinner
tip: Resident and guest house DJs. Go for sunset over the river, then head up one level to SIN Rooftop. Reserve.

name: Escape Bangkok
vibe: Mall-top terrace bar with house DJs, and a past venue for Mustache takeover nights
tip: Weekends get busy. Commercial house and pop edits on peak nights. Good pre-party a short walk from BTS Phrom Phong.

name: FVTURE Bangkok
vibe: 6,000-capacity hyperclub on an L-Acoustics rig, booking CamelPhat, Kolsch and ARTBAT
tip: Opened Dec 2025. Check IG and Ticketmelon for headliner nights, which sell out. Buy online, dress smart, 20+.

name: MOJJO Rooftop Lounge & Bar
vibe: Boho rooftop lounge with a live DJ and Latin-to-house sets over Phrom Phong
tip: Open 6pm-1:30am. Go up a few floors to Vanilla Sky for a quieter nightcap. Best at sunset.

name: Tulum Sky Bar (Mövenpick Ekkamai)
vibe: Tulum-styled 29th-floor terrace for golden-hour beats on the Ekkamai side
tip: Come for sunset, when the beats are on. Then walk to Berlin BKK or Blaq Lyte Rover nearby for the late session.

name: Taling Chan Floating Market (ตลาดน้ำตลิ่งชัน)
vibe: Weekend canal market where you eat grilled river prawns on floating rafts with live Thai music
tip: Go Sat or Sun before 11am. Long-tail boat loops leave from the pier to orchid gardens and Wat Kok, about 1 hour.

name: Song Khlong Floating Market at Wat Taling Chan (ตลาดน้ำวัดตลิ่งชัน)
vibe: Quieter twin of the main market, inside a temple, known for old-school tom yum pork noodles and homemade ice cream
tip: Walk 100 m from the main Taling Chan market and do both in one morning. Weekends only, closes around 3pm.

name: Taling Chan Canal Long-tail Boat Tour
vibe: Putter down Khlong Chak Phra and Bangkok Noi past stilt houses, orchards and Ayutthaya-era temples
tip: Shared boats run from the floating market pier on weekend afternoons. The Wat Kok loop is about 60 baht a seat, roughly 1 hour.

name: Wat Saphan Floating Market (ตลาดน้ำวัดสะพาน)
vibe: Tiny local-only canal market behind an Ayutthaya temple, with bananas fried right on a rowing boat
tip: Cash only. Feed the fat temple fish and see the three big Buddha images. Weekends 8am to 3pm.

name: Wat Champa (วัดจำปา)
vibe: Late-Ayutthaya temple with porcelain-studded gables, a never-dry holy pond and a sleepy village floating market
tip: Off Phutthamonthon Sai 1 Soi 22. Pair it with nearby Khlong Lat Mayom market on a weekend morning.

name: Wat Ta Khian & Floating Market (วัดตะเคียน)
vibe: Enter a basement shrine through a tiger's mouth, exit via a dragon, meet a selfie-taking ogre and a statue rock band
tip: Canal market runs daily, busiest on weekends. Grab a car or bike there; public transport is a long walk.

name: Wat Chalo boat temple (วัดชลอ)
vibe: An ordination hall built as a giant Suphannahong royal barge, plus a 1730s junk-shaped hall beside it
tip: Weekday mornings are quietest for photos. Short taxi from MRT Bang O or Bang Yi Khan.

name: Wat Suwannaram (วัดสุวรรณาราม)
vibe: Junk-curved Ayutthaya hall with some of Bangkok's finest Rama III murals, and a famous haunted reputation
tip: Walk from Charan Soi 32. Combine with the Ban Bu bronze workshop and the canal-side Wat Thong market next door.

name: Ban Bu Bronze Bowl Workshop (Jiam Saengsajja) & Khon mask painting
vibe: Last stone-polished bronze bowl makers in Bangkok, six generations deep, hammering away in a canal-side lane
tip: Weekdays 10:00-16:00, free to watch. A short walk away you can paint a mini Khon mask for about 120 baht.

name: Wat Sri Sudaram (วัดศรีสุดาราม)
vibe: Canal temple where poet Sunthorn Phu studied as a boy, with a statue of the young poet in the grounds
tip: Locals still call it Wat Chi Pakhao. Check the exact pin in Maps; it sits by Khlong Bangkok Noi near Wat Suwannaram.

name: Wat Dusitaram murals (วัดดุสิตาราม)
vibe: Riverside temple whose ordination hall mural is rated among the most beautiful of the Rattanakosin era
tip: Right next to CHANN Bangkok Noi, so do murals then a riverside coffee. Dress modestly.

name: ARCH x CHANN Cafe (CHANN Bangkok Noi)
vibe: Dark-wood minimalist cafe inside a hidden boutique hotel with a lawn right on the Chao Phraya
tip: Open to non-guests. Late afternoon for river light; stays open to 22:00 on Fri-Sun.

name: N10 Cafe (Baan Wanglang Riverside)
vibe: Riverfront parlour cafe near Wat Rakhang with indoor AC and outdoor seats facing the Grand Palace side
tip: Good stop after Wang Lang market. Set lunch available; outdoor seats best near sunset.

name: Wat Rakhang (วัดระฆังโฆสิตาราม)
vibe: Riverside temple of bells where you ring rows of bronze bells for luck, then watch the sun drop over the river
tip: Take the cross-river ferry from Tha Chang. Feed the fish at the pier; temple closes 17:00 but the pier stays open.

name: Siriraj Bimuksthan Museum (old Bangkok Noi station)
vibe: Old Thonburi railway station turned museum on Thonburi history, with a WWII Japanese steam loco parked outside
tip: Different from the Siriraj 'death' museum. Arrive by Chao Phraya boat to Railway Station Pier.

name: Charan Sanitwong Halt: Death Railway train to River Kwai
vibe: Flag down the slow 3rd-class train to the Bridge on the River Kwai at a level crossing under your local MRT
tip: Halt is under MRT Bang Khun Non, Exit 2. Foreigners pay a flat 100 baht. Morning and afternoon trains; check SRT times.

name: Central Pinklao (The Park on Fifth)
vibe: Freshly rebuilt west-side mall with an open-skylight green hangout floor and 200+ restaurants
tip: Head to the 5th floor park for coffee. IMAX Laser cinema and Soundcheck karaoke for rainy nights.

name: The Circle Ratchaphruek
vibe: Open-air lifestyle 'town' of five little streets packed with Japanese izakayas, omakase and dessert cafes
tip: Best after dark. Shakariki432 izakaya stays open to 1am; pop-up markets run some weekends.

name: Talad Thonburi (Sanam Luang 2) plant market
vibe: Huge plant and orchid market with pets, secondhand stuff and a coconut-grove canal park for jogging
tip: Busiest Sat-Sun when the secondhand stalls appear. New plants arrive on Wednesdays. First parking hour free.

name: Little Hideout Patisserie
vibe: Shady garden cafe under big trees with French-style pastries ranked among Bangkok's top bakeries
tip: Come at opening or late afternoon on weekends for a seat. Some cakes are weekend-only. Likely closed Mondays.

name: Limitless Roaster Suan Phak
vibe: Calm dark-green specialty roastery with a koi pond out front
tip: Order the iced pour-over and a rosemary croissant. Easy stop on the way to Wat Ta Khian.

name: RAWVAELA Cafe (รอเวลา คาเฟ่)
vibe: Cozy Western cottage cafe with a fireplace, right beside Khlong Lat Mayom floating market
tip: Perfect cool-down after the weekend market. Try the s'mores cake.

name: 128 Craft & Soul
vibe: Soft-yellow French-village style cafe with a lawn, mousse desserts and craft coffee
tip: Off Pak Nam Krachom Thong Soi 20. Reported closed Thursdays. Open to 21:00 on weekends.

name: The Salil House (เดอะ สลิล เฮาส์)
vibe: Hidden big house with stained glass, East-meets-West decor and waterside outdoor tables
tip: Few reviews so far, so it stays quiet. Order the potato croquettes with salted fish.

name: Rolling Roasters (Phran Nok-Phutthamonthon)
vibe: Big airy branch of a well-loved Bangkok roaster with yuzu cheesecake and banoffee
tip: Lots of parking and space, good for working. Nearby Twist does chef-run Italian if you stay for dinner.

name: Twist (Italian)
vibe: Small chef-run Italian spot doing truffle pappardelle and scarlet panna cotta far from the tourist crowds
tip: Small room, so book for dinner on weekends.

name: Scene Bangkok Patisserie & Brasserie
vibe: Large photogenic French-style patisserie with a Matcha Bomb and almond croissants
tip: Open late for a dessert spot; kitchen closes earlier than the cafe.

name: Talay Ma Talay Ma (ทะเลมา ทะเลมา)
vibe: Cafe by morning, steak and fried-chicken-waffle restaurant by night
tip: Go for dinner: ribeye and maple fried chicken waffle are the picks.

name: Chamthing (cafe + rooftop bar)
vibe: Four-floor hangout with a giant cherry sculpture out front, cafe by day, live-music rooftop bar by night
tip: Rooftop opens in the evening. Look for 1-for-1 cocktail promos and food discounts before 21:00.

name: Watcharapirom hidden bar (วัชรภิรมณ์)
vibe: 4th-floor secret bar with pool, board games, art on the walls and a balcony over the expressway lights
tip: Look for the Shell station and footbridge near Borom Soi 30, then the white building. Book window seats.

name: The Most Bar & Bistro Ratchaphruek
vibe: Big loft-style bar with a strong sound system, live bands from 8pm and charcoal-oven pizza
tip: Private karaoke rooms for groups. Parking on site.

name: Adamus Cafe by the River
vibe: Vintage riverside garden cafe with a classic-car corner and bridge views, best in the evening glow
tip: Entrance through the Lotus's Charan car park. Closed Mondays. Halal, with a prayer room.

name: Moon River Silk Dining (มูน ริเวอร์)
vibe: Three-floor riverside Thai seafood spot staring straight at the Phra Nang Klao Bridge
tip: Come before sunset for a top-floor river table; exit Phra Nang Klao Bridge toward Wat Sai Ma Nuea

name: Samsen Life - The River
vibe: Two-story black-wood river house with open decks, big Thai plates and the odd live band
tip: Grab the open-air upper deck after dark; open late, so it works as a riverside drinks stop too

name: The Waterside at Chesadabodin
vibe: Riverside Thai dining right under Thailand's first extradosed bridge, lit up at night
tip: Closed Mondays; there is parking, and the bridge lights make dinner better than lunch

name: Maha Chesadabodindranusorn Bridge (สะพานมหาเจษฎาบดินทรานุสรณ์)
vibe: Thailand's first extradosed bridge: sleek cable towers over the Chao Phraya, glowing at night
tip: Best seen from the riverbank restaurants on either side or from the Nonthaburi express boat at dusk

name: Nonthaburi Museum (Old Provincial Hall)
area: Tha Nam Nonthaburi pier, Mueang Nonthaburi
vibe: Gorgeous Rama VI-era teak hall on the river with pottery, orchard and local history rooms
tip: Free entry; closed Mondays. Ride the express boat to the last stop (N30) and it is right at the pier

name: Tha Nam Nonthaburi Pier Market and Clock Tower
vibe: Busy old-town pier hub with a 1957 clock tower, riverside market and famous 7-color chive cakes
tip: Hunt for the 7-color kuichai stall by the clock tower, then take the 4-baht ferry to Wat Chaloem Phra Kiat
hours: Daily, busiest mornings and early evening

name: Wat Chaloem Phra Kiat Worawihan
vibe: Rama III royal temple behind fortress walls, Thai-Chinese ubosot and a 45 m white chedi
tip: Cross-river ferry from Nonthaburi pier is the fun way in; usually quiet, great late afternoon light

name: Wat Khema Phirataram
area: Suan Yai, Mueang Nonthaburi (Phibun Songkhram Rd)
vibe: Ayutthaya-era royal temple with a 30 m relic chedi and the old Red Palace hall
tip: Wat Khema express boat pier is close by; no entry fee

name: Wat Sangkhathan (วัดสังฆทาน)
vibe: Leafy forest monastery with a glass ubosot housing Luang Pho To; a real calm-down spot
tip: Dress modestly and keep quiet; they run meditation day visits and retreats

name: Wat Chomphuwek (วัดชมภูเวก)
vibe: 1757 Mon temple with a famous Mother Earth mural and a Mon-style chedi
tip: Look for the Thorani (earth goddess) mural in the old ordination hall, one of Thailand's best

name: Wat Prasat (วัดปราสาท)
vibe: Tiny 300-year-old temple with a curved ship-hull ubosot and rare Ayutthaya murals
tip: A short ride from Bang Khun Non; murals are fragile, so no flash and ask before entering

name: Wat Bang Phai (วัดบางไผ่)
area: Bang Rak Phatthana, Bang Bua Thong
vibe: Temple with fortress-style bastion walls and a glittering gilded glass-mosaic ordination hall
tip: Off Bang Kruai-Sai Noi Rd; combine with Central WestGate nearby

name: Bang Khu Wiang Floating Market (ตลาดน้ำบางคูเวียง)
vibe: Dawn trading by boat with monks collecting alms on the water; zero tourist polish
tip: Go Sat or Sun around 06:00-08:00 for the real boat market; later it becomes a regular stall market

name: Grazia Gelato and Coffee
area: Nakhon In Rd, Bang Khu Wiang, Bang Kruai
vibe: Retro European-style house serving properly good Italian gelato and pastries
tip: Try the pistachio or tiramisu gelato; it is a 5-minute walk from Wat Takhian market

name: The Glasshouse Cafe
area: Nakhon In Rd, Bang Khun Kong, Bang Kruai
vibe: Glass-walled garden cafe known for coconut cake and Thai-Western brunch plates
tip: Closed Tuesdays; near Talad Rama 5, easy hop from Bang Khun Non

name: Bake Me Tender (เบคมีเทนเดอร์)
area: Nakhon In Rd / Rama 5 roundabout, Bang Kruai
vibe: Long-running cake house and fusion bistro, a local favorite for birthday-level desserts
tip: Closed Mondays; good evening dessert stop since it runs until 21:00

name: Three Mangoes Riverside (ทรีแมงโก้ ริมน้ำ)
area: Nakhon In Rd, Bang Khanun, Bang Kruai
vibe: Rustic Thai wooden house on the water with canal-side seating, open late
tip: Access is via the Wat Sangthan or Wat Khang Khao lanes; check the map before driving in

name: Owl Market (ตลาดนกฮูก)
area: Liang Mueang Rd behind Central Rattanathibet, Mueang Nonthaburi
vibe: Huge local evening flea market: street food, food trucks, vintage, collectibles and cheap clothes
tip: Goes late; come hungry after 18:00. Few vendors speak English, so have cash and a translator app

name: Fantasia Lagoon Water Park
area: The Mall Lifestore Ngamwongwan, Mueang Nonthaburi
vibe: Rooftop tropical water park on a mall's 6th floor with slides, splash tower and lazy river
tip: Call ahead for ticket prices (061-046-2811); weekdays are much quieter

name: Central WestGate
vibe: One of Thailand's biggest malls: cinema, indoor amusement zone, huge food court, IKEA next door
tip: Purple Line MRT Talad Bang Yai drops you at the door; watch for weekend pop-up markets

name: The Old School Specialty Coffee & Roastery (Bang Yai)
area: Kanchanaphisek Rd, Bang Rak Phatthana, Bang Bua Thong
vibe: School-themed roastery with an English garden, koi pond and fountains
tip: Free parking right off Kanchanaphisek; they run coffee classes, ask at the bar
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/en/food-blog/คาเฟ่นนทบุรี/

name: Wat Paramaiyikawat Leaning Chedi (Ko Kret)
vibe: Ko Kret's icon: the white Mon chedi leaning over the river, plus a Mon pottery museum
tip: 3-5 baht ferry from Wat Sanam Nuea pier lands you right here; park at Wat Sanam Nuea

name: Wat Bang Chak (วัดบางจาก)
area: Bang Tanai, Pak Kret (opposite Ko Kret)
vibe: Riverside temple with Nonthaburi's biggest Buddha, a crawl-under ubosot ritual and buffalo to feed
tip: Same soi as River Wine and Chang Wang Imm, so do temple at sunset then dinner

name: Chang Wang Imm (จางวางอิ่ม)
area: Soi Wat Bang Chak, Bang Tanai, Pak Kret
vibe: Antique-filled old house on the riverbank facing Ko Kret, serving old-school Thai curries
tip: Try the pork crackling fried rice; book a river-edge table for sunset

name: River Wine Restaurant & Wine Bar
area: Soi Wat Bang Chak, under Rama IV Bridge, Pak Kret
vibe: Riverside wine bar under the Rama IV Bridge with mellow live music and private karaoke rooms
tip: Go after dark for the bridge lights; wine by the bottle is the move for groups

name: Suan Thip (สวนทิพย์)
area: Soi Wat Ku, Bang Phut, Pak Kret
vibe: Michelin Guide-listed royal Thai cooking in shady riverside gardens with ponds and pavilions
tip: Book ahead on weekends; order the kaeng khi lek curry and crispy sea bass with green mango

name: Wat Ku (Queen Sunanda Memorial)
vibe: Riverside temple marking Queen Sunanda's 1880 royal boat tragedy, with replica royal boats
tip: Walkable from Suan Thip, so make it a lunch plus temple combo

name: Wat Saeng Siritham Floating Market
vibe: Raft-style weekend market on the Chao Phraya with snacks, Ko Kret goods and river-view seats
tip: Weekends only; pair with Ko Kret, which is just upriver

name: Wat Yai Sawang Arom Riverside Market
area: Om Kret, Pak Kret (west bank facing Ko Kret)
vibe: Old west-bank temple with a weekend riverside market and views across to Ko Kret
tip: Saturday and Sunday only; quieter than the Ko Kret walking street

name: Hidden Backyard Cafe & Hangout
vibe: Secret bamboo-jungle garden by a pond: cafe by day, fairy-lit craft beer and cocktail hangout by night
tip: Evenings are the vibe but it gets busy; parking is limited, so grab a taxi
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/en/food-blog/คาเฟ่นนทบุรี/

name: IMPACT Arena Muang Thong Thani
vibe: 12,000-seat arena where the big K-pop, Thai and international concerts land
tip: Check the IMPACT event calendar; MRT Pink Line Impact Muang Thong Thani station is right there

name: The Club Khaosan
vibe: The big one: three-level 1,500-cap club with Funktion-One sound, LED wall and tech house till 4am
tip: Tech house, bass house, EDM. Peaks midnight to 2am Fri-Sat. 20+, bring passport. Cover 0-300 THB some nights

name: Rocco Club Rooftop
vibe: Corner rooftop above the Khao San chaos that turns into a DJ party later in the night
tip: Go for sunset drinks, stay past 11pm when the DJ cranks up. Hip-hop nights some Saturdays. Slightly pricier than street bars

name: The One Khaosan
vibe: Open-air stadium-seating party bar with nightly DJs and the best view of the Khao San crowd
tip: Perfect pre-club spot next door to The Club. DJs and MC every night, busiest 10pm-1am. Beers 100-150, buckets 250-350 THB

name: Brick Bar
vibe: Huge brick hall packed with young Thais jumping to live ska, reggae and Thai rock bands
tip: Bands from about 8:30pm, best 10pm+ Thu-Sat. Arrive by 9:30pm for a table. No real cover, buy a drink. Beers 120-180 THB

name: Mulligans Irish Bar Khaosan
vibe: Air-conned Irish pub with football on screens early and drunken singalongs late
tip: Good escape from the heat with Kilkenny on tap. Sports early, best after midnight. Pints 180-260 THB

name: The Roof Bar (Centre Point Plaza)
vibe: Open-air 3rd-floor terrace over Khao San with three live sets a night
tip: Acoustic 7:30pm, full band 9:30-11:30pm, another band till late. Grab a rail seat. Check your change

name: Sanay Rooftop Bar Khaosan
vibe: The prettiest rooftop near Khao San: creative cocktails, sunset over Banglamphu, rated 4.8
tip: Come for sunset, cocktails 180-320 THB, beers 100-160. Weekend DJ after 10pm plays house-lite and Afrobeats

name: Hippie de Bar
vibe: Hidden retro hangout down an alley off Khao San, with vintage junk decor, pool table and indie tunes
tip: Best early (8-11pm) before the big clubs. Courtyard seating, indie, pop and hip-hop. Beers 100-150 THB

name: Rere Khaosan
vibe: Restaurant by day that flips into a DJ dance spot after dark and goes till 4am
tip: DJs from about 10pm with commercial house and pop. Good last stop when the rest close at 2am

name: Khok Wua Afrobeats
vibe: Sweaty little Afrobeats, dancehall and R&B dance bar for when you want a different groove
tip: Goes late, roughly 10pm-4am. Gets going after midnight. Live DJs, no dress code

name: Immortal Bar (Open Air)
vibe: Khao San's rock, punk and metal den, with loud bands and cheap drinks under the open sky
tip: Don't bother before 10:30pm. Live rock and metal acts some nights. Closed Mondays. No cover

name: Molly Bar
vibe: Two-floor Rambuttri favorite: live cover band downstairs, DJ party upstairs
tip: Start with the band, finish upstairs with the DJ. Cocktails around 230 THB. Busy every night

name: Buttri
vibe: Highly rated Rambuttri lane bar (4.9 from 800+ reviews) with live performances and a friendly crowd
tip: Calmer than Khao San but still lively. Live acts in the evening. Good spot to start or wind down

name: Reggae Bar Bangkok
vibe: Tiny reggae shack with acoustic and full live bands, rated 4.7 and properly laid-back
tip: Live bands Thu-Sat after 9:30pm. Cheap beers, pay as you order. Closes at midnight

name: Kalanbatu Reggae Bar
vibe: Rasta-style lane bar with a live band from 9pm and some of the cheapest booze around
tip: Band starts around 9pm. Reggae core, mixed covers. Open till 2am most nights

name: Happy Bar
vibe: Decades-old no-pressure live music bar, a little local institution on the lane
tip: Low-key live sets every night. Check the bill, some reviews mention price slips

name: Hide Cafe Bar (Tani Road)
vibe: Cozy 24-hour hideout with pool table, board games and a cannabis-friendly smoking area
tip: Your 4am option when everything shuts. Thai-style beer on ice, fair prices. 5.0 from 300+ reviews

name: Madame Musur
vibe: Northern Thai lounge-bar under the trees with herbal cocktails and a beachy Khao San feel
tip: Best 7-9pm for dinner plus drinks before heading out. Herbal cocktails 220-300 THB

name: Mad Monkey Bangkok
vibe: Khao San's go-to party hostel bar with a pool, beer pong and nightly pub crawls
tip: Non-guests can usually drink at the bar. Join the pub crawl to meet people fast. Sat pool BBQ

name: Sheepshank Public House
vibe: Former boathouse turned industrial gastropub with a river deck made for sunset pints
tip: Arrive at golden hour for the deck, stay for craft beer and burgers. Calm, couple-friendly

name: The Roof at The StandardX Phra Arthit
vibe: Design-hotel rooftop pool bar with river views and Mexican bites, the stylish new kid on Phra Arthit
tip: Sunset is the move. Cocktails and tacos by the pool, more polished crowd than Khao San. Opened late 2024

name: Apron Bar
vibe: Pour-your-own craft beer bar with 18 taps inside an analogue film photo lab
tip: Tap card system, drafts 145-218 THB, so watch your pours. Mostly Underdog brews. Closed Mondays

name: Phranakorn Bar & Gallery
vibe: Arty multi-floor bar with a gallery inside and a rooftop looking over Golden Mount and old Bangkok
tip: Head straight up to the roof deck. Thai student and arts crowd, live bands. Cocktails 200-250, drafts 190-230

name: Din Restaurant & Jazz Bar
vibe: Elegant shophouse jazz bar inside a boutique hotel, live jazz quartets and signature cocktails
tip: Live jazz Thu-Sat and Sun evenings. Arrive for the second set. Closed Mondays

name: The Press Sky Bar (Printing House Poshtel)
vibe: 9th-floor hostel rooftop with skyline views and a mellower, grown-up social crowd
tip: Early-evening sundowner spot near Democracy Monument. Sharing packs from about 1,550 THB for two

name: Tai Soon Bar
vibe: Dim Chinese-shophouse craft beer bar with 13 taps, across from Jay Fai and Pad Thai Thip Samai
tip: Combine with a Pratu Phi street-food night. Ask for tasters. Fills up after 8pm

name: Samranrat Bar
vibe: Small neighborhood bar near Pratu Phi rated 4.9, with cocktails, burgers and Thai drinking food
tip: Easy pre or post spot for a Tai Soon and Pratu Phi food crawl. Mojitos and margaritas, cheap eats

name: 342bar (Baan Wanglang Riverside rooftop)
vibe: Open-air hotel rooftop right on the river, Rama VIII Bridge and Grand Palace side lights across the water.
tip: Go for sunset, 16:00-23:00 daily. Cocktails around 220-380 THB, beer 130-200. Card minimum 500 THB.

name: Ta-ling Bar (ตลิ่งบาร์)
vibe: Riverside semi-pub in the alley by Siriraj pier, cold beer on the bank with a live band.
tip: Open 10:00-23:00. Best after 19:00 when the band starts. Around 250-500 THB per head with food.

name: Tanee Beer Tap (ตานี เบียร์แท็ป)
vibe: Small Thai craft beer tap bar in Wang Lang, rotating IPAs and Thai bar food. Your closest craft beer spot.
tip: Open 16:00-24:00 daily. Pair with 342bar next door: tap beer first, rooftop after. Craft pints around 200-300 THB.

name: Beeru Bar & Bistro
vibe: Hidden izakaya-style bar near Rama VIII Bridge, Japanese bites and a big drinks list.
tip: Tue-Sun 17:00-23:00, 100 m into Soi Arun Amarin 53. Try the chashu and cheese gyoza. 250-500 THB per head.

name: Eagle Nest Bar (Sala Arun)
vibe: Tiny 5th floor riverside perch staring straight at Wat Arun lit up at night. Quiet, no loud music.
tip: Weekdays 17:00-24:00, weekends 16:30-01:00. Sunset seats go first. Cocktails about 280-420 THB, beer 150-200.

name: View ARUN (Arun Riverside)
vibe: Multi-level riverside rooftop terraces facing Wat Arun, house-syrup cocktails and regional Thai food.
tip: Book a front terrace table for sunset. Cocktails about 280-480 THB, beer 120-190. Call 02-221-5651 to reserve.

name: Eat Sight Story Deck
vibe: Riverside deck restaurant-bar at the end of Soi Tha Tien, Wat Arun right across the water.
tip: Come before sunset for a river-edge table, have drinks while Wat Arun lights up. Book on 083-988-8735.
hours: Lunch to late evening, confirm by phone

name: Nuss Bar (Nusara)
vibe: Red velvet cocktail lounge beside 50 Best restaurant Nusara, with a full-width window onto Wat Pho.
tip: Wed-Mon 17:00-24:00, closed Tue. Only around 30 seats, book. Try the Three Friends Negroni. Cocktails 400+ THB.

name: Mayrai Wine Bar (Tha Tien)
vibe: Le Du team's natural wine bar in an old shophouse opposite Sala Rattanakosin, with pad thai to match.
tip: Closed Tue. Glasses from about 200 THB. Good warm-up before the Tha Tien rooftops. Hours have shortened, check first.

name: Uncle Tim (Tim Mansion)
vibe: Red-neon Chinese herb cocktail bar in an old pharmacy next to Jay Fai. Late Saturdays get techno-house DJs.
tip: Wed-Sun 19:00-01:00. Saturday late night is the DJ / tech house slot, jazz Wed, Fri and Sun. Herbal cocktails.

name: QasBar
vibe: Speakeasy in an 80-year-old three-floor house near the Giant Swing, board games and glass painting.
tip: 18:00-01:30, closed Mon. 2-hour cocktail buffet 999 THB, beer buffet promos around 559 THB. Live music some Saturdays.

name: COLLECTED
vibe: Small neighbourhood natural wine bar in the old town, orange wine, Thai craft beer and easy chat.
tip: Wed-Sun 17:00-24:00. Staff happily guide newbies. Great quiet first-date spot before rooftop drinks.

name: Seven Spoons
vibe: Long-running candlelit bar-restaurant with an open bar up front, Mediterranean plates and solid cocktails.
tip: Dinner 18:00-01:00, closed Mon. Cocktails from around 250 THB. Good dinner-then-drinks date in the old town.

name: Haze Bar
vibe: Genuine neighbourhood craft beer local: 12 mostly Thai taps, live music and sports on screen.
tip: 18:00-24:00, Wed-Mon per Time Out. Thai craft pints around 200-280 THB. Easy walk from Saphan Phut side.

name: Taophiphon Bar Project
vibe: Craft beer activist MP's bar: 200+ beers, Thai community spirits and sato, board games and live music.
tip: Wed-Mon 17:00-24:00. Chill live music Fri and Sat. Ask for local Thai spirits flights. South of the main area, near Wongwian Yai.

name: 109MHz BKK Pinklao
vibe: Newer live music semi-pub in The Sense Pinklao, cold drinks, mala and fried shrimp heads.
tip: Evenings, band from around 20:00. Easy parking. Cheap mixers and beer towers, around 150-300 THB per head.

name: Faah BKK
vibe: Pricier live music bar in The Sense Pinklao complex, the dressier Pinklao night out.
tip: Weekend nights are busiest. Bottle-focused, budget 500+ THB per head. Hop to 109MHz in the same complex.

name: Rusty.bkk
vibe: Hidden red-lit Pinklao bar with a spiral staircase, signature cocktails, band and DJ every night.
tip: Live music plus DJ nightly. Try the Love Potion No.9. Beside Pata Pinklao, easy parking, reasonable prices.

name: Tidtrain Rooftop Bar (ติดเทรน)
vibe: Budget rooftop beside the MRT line with Rama VIII Bridge views. Trains roll past your table.
tip: Daily 17:00-24:00, near MRT Sirindhorn. Menu from 89 THB. Cheap sunset beers, easy taxi home to Bangkok Noi.

name: River Bar (Club Retro)
vibe: Old-school riverside bar-restaurant facing Rama VIII and Krung Thon bridges, with a live band.
tip: Daily 17:00-24:00. Grab a river table for bridge lights. Thai drinking food, beer towers, live music nightly.

name: Groove Evening
vibe: Roadside Pinklao bar-bistro with a fountain courtyard, nightly bands and a monthly pool tournament.
tip: Daily 17:30-01:00. Draft and black beer at moderate prices, spicy yum snacks. Older listing, check it is still running.

name: Kiew Nong Bua Wang Lang (เกี๊ยวหนองบัว วังหลัง)
vibe: 50-year-old Trat-style wonton noodle house with a river-view cafe upstairs
tip: Get wonton egg noodles and pork dumplings in clear broth, then dessert on the 2nd floor. 9am-9pm. Parking in Wat Rakhang.

name: Theatre Cafe at Theatre Residence (เธียเตอร์ เรสซิเดนซ์)
vibe: Former Patravadi open-air theatre turned leafy riverside restaurant with a waterfall and Grand Palace views
tip: Clam croquettes, corn ribs with somtum shrimp dip, catfish fried rice. Book a river table for sunset dinner.

name: Supatra River House (สุภัทรา ริเวอร์ เฮาส์)
vibe: Restored teak house of the woman who founded Bangkok's river ferries, reopened in 2024 after five years
tip: Duck confit larb and nam prik long ruea with fluffy catfish. Ask for the small building for best river view. Book ahead.
hours: Lunch and dinner; book ahead (older listing: 11:00-14:00, 17:30-23:00)

name: Jum Saep Aum Lam Phen Wa (จุ่มแซ่บ อุ๋มหล่ำ เพ็นวา)
area: Wang Lang Road, near Wang Lang Pier
vibe: Spicy Isan hot pots and grills on a breezy balcony over the Chao Phraya
tip: Jim jum hot pot, larb and grilled pork with cold beer at dusk. Good for groups. 11am-10pm.

name: Kaenkrung (แก่นกรุง)
vibe: Michelin-listed modern Isan from Khon Kaen, bold, smoky and properly spicy
tip: Order the signature Hao Dong herb-grilled pork neck plus a som tam. Closed Tue-Wed. Mid-range, good dinner spot.

name: Jae Uan Hoy Yai Kratha Ron (เจ๊อ้วนหอยใหญ่ กระทะร้อน)
vibe: Sizzling hot-pan fried oysters with fat, juicy shellfish in a crispy egg batter
tip: Get hoy tod on the hot plate with extra sriracha. Go before 7pm. Budget ฿100-150.
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/food-blog/ร้านอาหารวังหลัง/

name: Sushi Wang Lang by Orathai (ซูชิวังหลัง บาย อรทัย)
area: Arun Amarin Road, Wang Lang market
vibe: Viral 6-baht-a-piece sushi counter that students and TikTokers swarm
tip: Pick your own pieces at 6 baht each, ramen and rice bowls too. Go mid-afternoon to dodge the student rush.
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/food-blog/ร้านอาหารวังหลัง/

name: Jok Hia Kriang (โจ๊กเฮียเกรียง)
vibe: Old-school Wang Lang congee stall loaded with pork, liver, offal and century egg
tip: Jok with everything plus a raw egg. Opens 6am for breakfast and runs to 9:30pm. Tue only from 4pm.
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/food-blog/ร้านอาหารวังหลัง/

name: Tee Yen Ta Fo Rot Ded (ตี๋เย็นตาโฟรสเด็ด)
area: Siriraj Hospital intersection, Wang Lang Road
vibe: Bright pink yen ta fo noodles with fish balls and tofu, a Siriraj staple
tip: Yen ta fo sen yai with fried wonton crisps. Cheap, fast lunch. Open 9am-9pm.
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/food-blog/ร้านอาหารวังหลัง/

name: Tub Tim Krob Wang Lang (ทับทิมกรอบวังหลัง)
vibe: Crunchy ruby water chestnuts in coconut milk over shaved ice, the perfect heat cure
tip: Get the classic tub tim krob with extra jackfruit. Around ฿40-60. Best in the hot afternoon.
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/food-blog/ร้านอาหารวังหลัง/

name: Yui Khao Chae Wang Lang (ยุ้ยข้าวแช่ วังหลัง)
vibe: Royal-style khao chae: rice in jasmine-scented ice water with fussy little side dishes
tip: Try it on a hot day, mostly in the dry season (Mar-May). Eat the sides first, then sip the rice. Daytime only.
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/food-blog/ร้านอาหารวังหลัง/

name: Khanom Krok Singapore OK (ขนมครกสิงคโปร์ OK)
vibe: Singapore-style coconut pancakes with fun toppings from pandan to durian to pork floss
tip: Mix a box of pandan, durian and shrimp. Morning stall, 7:30am-3pm, so come early.
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/food-blog/ร้านอาหารวังหลัง/

name: Kuay Teow Tamlueng Nai Uan (ก๋วยเตี๋ยวตำลึงนายอ้วน บางขุนนนท์)
vibe: Bang Khun Non noodle-street classic famous for tom yum noodles loaded with ivy gourd greens
tip: Tom yum noodles or tom yum yen ta fo, plus a braised egg. Under ฿100. Morning to 4pm.

name: Ham Hu Tom Yum Soy Milk Noodles (ร้านหำหู้ ก๋วยเตี๋ยวต้มยำน้ำเต้าหู้)
vibe: Bills itself as the only shop in Thailand doing tom yum noodles in soy milk broth. Weird and wonderful
tip: Order the signature tom yum nam tao hu noodles, spicy level medium. Cheap. Go lunchtime.

name: Bami Jab Kang Yai Pi (บะหมี่จับกังยายปิ๊ ปากซอยจรัญฯ46)
area: Charan Sanitwong Soi 46, Bang Yi Khan
vibe: Grandma Pi's 'labourer' egg noodles: tiny bowls, tiny prices, huge local cult
tip: Dry bami with wonton and red pork at ฿30, order two bowls. Opens 6am, cash only, sells out.

name: Iaw Thai Suki Boran (เอี่ยวไถ่สุกี้โบราณ)
vibe: 30-plus-year-old Pinklao suki shop famous for thick-broth beef suki
tip: Order suki nuea nam khon (thick beef suki), wet or dry. Open late-ish to 10:30pm.
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/food-blog/ร้านอาหารปิ่นเกล้า/

name: Sky High Tom Yum Chicken Feet (สกายไฮ)
vibe: Legendary Ratchadamnoen khao tom shop, now at Pinklao, known for fiery 'super' chicken feet tom yum
tip: Tom yum kha gai super plus yum hoy kraeng cockle salad with plain rice porridge. 8:30am-9:30pm.

name: Meng Phochana Pinklao (เม้งโภชนาปิ่นเกล้า)
vibe: Local favourite for stewed beef noodles and plump shrimp dumplings
tip: Stewed beef noodles plus a plate of boiled pork and shrimp dumplings. Cheap. 9am-5pm.
sources: https://www.grab.com/th/food-blog/ร้านอาหารปิ่นเกล้า/

name: Krua Apsorn Samsen (ครัวอัปษร สามเสน)
vibe: Michelin Bib Gourmand 2026: royal-kitchen-trained cooking at casual prices
tip: Crab omelette, yellow curry with big prawns and crispy lotus root. Cash only. Lunch queues, 10am-8pm.

name: Pad Thai Fai Ta Lu (ผัดไทยไฟทะลุ)
vibe: Bib Gourmand wok-fire pad thai with flames shooting through the roof, open till midnight
tip: Pad thai with charcoal-grilled pork loin or big prawns. Around ฿100-250. Great late dinner after Khao San.

name: K. Panich Sticky Rice (ข้าวเหนียวมูน ก.พานิช)
area: Tanao Road, near Sao Ching Cha
vibe: Bib Gourmand sticky rice shop since 1932, the benchmark for mango sticky rice
tip: Mango sticky rice, or try the Thai custard and durian versions. Takeaway, closed Sundays.

name: Sae Phun Chicken Stew (แซ่พุ้น)
vibe: Bib Gourmand morning shop for rich, saucy Chinese-style chicken stew
tip: Chicken stew over rice or crispy egg noodles. Closes 2pm and Wednesdays, so go for breakfast or early lunch.

name: Por Pochaya (ป.โภชยา)
area: Wisut Kasat Road, Ban Phan Thom
vibe: Bib Gourmand Thai-Chinese shophouse, crowded, cash only, weekdays only
tip: Crab omelette and stir-fried beef with cumin leaves. Closed weekends and holidays. Arrive early for a table.

name: Aheesah Roddee (อาอีซะห์ รสดี)
vibe: Michelin-listed Thai-Muslim kitchen since 1975, steps from Khao San
tip: Chicken biryani with hot and sour beef soup, plus satay. Cash only. Closed Mondays.

name: Rongros (โรงรส)
vibe: Michelin-listed riverside Thai with a front-row view of Wat Arun lighting up
tip: Green curry with rib eye and roti, glass noodle salad. Book a window table for sunset. Last session 5-10pm.

name: Mae Prapha Crispy Pancake (ขนมเบื้องแม่ประภา)
vibe: Michelin-listed khanom bueang: paper-thin crispy Thai crepes, sweet or savory
tip: Mix a box of sweet (meringue and golden threads) and savory (shrimp). About ฿100. 9am-6pm.

name: Khun Daeng Kuay Jab Yuan (คุณแดง ก๋วยจั๊บญวน)
vibe: Cult Vietnamese-style chewy rice noodle soup with peppery pork sausage, a Phra Arthit legend
tip: Kuay jab yuan with a cracked egg (฿70) plus yum moo yor salad. Lunch queues. 9:30am-8:30pm.

name: Nai Soie Beef Noodles (ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเนื้อนายโส่ย)
vibe: Rich, tender braised beef noodles that Mark Wiens rates near Khao San
tip: Special beef noodles (around ฿80-100), or gao lao without noodles. 8am-6pm.

name: Karim Roti Mataba (การิม โรตี-มะตะบะ)
area: Phra Arthit Road, by Phra Sumen Fort
vibe: Decades-old Thai-Muslim roti joint facing Santichaiprakarn Park
tip: Murtabak with massaman curry, beef tongue biryani, then sweet roti with condensed milk. Closed Mon. Till 10:30pm.

name: Somsong Pochana (สมทรงโภชนา)
vibe: Rare Sukhothai-style noodles and hard-to-find old Thai dishes in a no-frills shophouse
tip: Sukhothai noodles, then khanom jeen sao nam with pineapple and coconut milk. Cheap. Closes 5pm.

name: Tom Yum Kung Banglamphu (ต้มยำกุ้งบางลำพู)
area: Soi Kraisi, by the Banglamphu car park
vibe: Sidewalk shop for creamy, punchy tom yum goong that Mark Wiens calls the ultimate
tip: Tom yum goong (around ฿150), yum hoy kraeng cockle salad and squid with chili jam. Daytime to about 6:30pm.

name: Khao Tom Bowon (ข้าวต้มบวร)
area: Opposite Wat Bowonniwet, near Khao San
vibe: 70-plus-year-old rice-porridge shop famous for braised five-spice duck
tip: Ped palo (braised duck) with plain khao tom and a couple of side dishes. Call 02 629 1739 to check hours.

name: Moo Pla Ra Ratchadamnoen (หมูปลาร้า ราชดำเนิน)
area: Soi off Ratchadamnoen, near Khok Wua intersection
vibe: Late-night grilled pork skewers eaten on floor mats with a free pla ra chili dip
tip: Moo ping ฿15 a stick, sticky rice ฿5, dunk in the free nam prik pla ra. Opens 8pm, come early, runs to 3am.

name: Wang Lang Bakery (วังหลังเบเกอรี่)
vibe: Market bakery known for soft stuffed buns in over two dozen fillings
tip: Grab a few stuffed buns (around ฿45-55) to eat by the river at Prannok. Daytime.

name: METRO Secret Homebar
area: Banglamphu / Khao San (Soi Kraisi, Tani Rd)
vibe: Tiny 'secret' home-style bar by the Banglamphu canal, a quiet escape from Khao San noise
tip: Small and easy to miss, so look for it on the canal side. Check Google reviews for current hours

name: Chill-D Rooftop Sunset Bar
area: Banglamphu / Khao San (Soi Kraisi, Tani Rd)
vibe: Laid-back backpacker rooftop for cheap sunset drinks above the Rambuttri rooftops
tip: Go around 17:30 for sunset. Cheap beers and buckets, casual dress

name: Sunset Rooftop Bar (Chakrabongse)
area: Banglamphu / Khao San (Soi Kraisi, Tani Rd)
vibe: Low-key rooftop near Chakrabongse Mosque with sunset views over the old town
tip: Best at golden hour. Budget prices, easy to combine with a Rambuttri crawl

name: HAVEN Rooftop Karaoke Bar
area: Banglamphu / Khao San (Soi Kraisi, Tani Rd)
vibe: Rooftop bar with karaoke on Soi Kraisi, where you sing over the Khao San skyline
tip: Go with a group after 21:00. Ask about private karaoke rooms and drink deals

name: Fu Bar Khaosan
area: Banglamphu / Khao San (Soi Kraisi, Tani Rd)
vibe: Small, loud late-night dance bar near Khao San that fills up after midnight
tip: Gets going after 23:00 and runs late. Cheap drinks; check recent reviews for the music style that night
